title: Mistbound Whispers

outfit_card.silhouette: Asymmetrical ballgown with corseted bodice, layered voluminous tulle skirt, and a cascading lace-trimmed overskirt veil; fitted lace sleeves with fingerless gloves.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Silver metallic floral fascinator with netted veil, feathery plumes, and trailing sheer ribbon streamers.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Strapless sweetheart bodice of sheer organza overlaid with intricate silver floral lace, pearl and crystal beadwork, and a sheer tulle neck ruffle; fitted lace gloves with scalloped edges.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Full tiered tulle skirt with scattered sequins, asymmetric lace-trimmed overskirt, and delicate fishnet lace stockings; pointed silver heels with ankle straps.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Translucent glittering parasol with ornate handle and cascading mist-like tulle, accompanied by floating butterfly motifs.
